description: I’m Chris Tierinni, a lifelong East Hartford resident dedicated to improving our community. As Vice President of JJ & C Contractors, I understand local business challenges. I’m involved in the community as President of the O’Connell School PTO, Vice President of East Hartford Little League, and a member of the Board of Education. My family and I volunteer with East Hartford’s Food Angels, always working to make a positive impact.
